div.div:
C 实现特点
• 直接操作码点值 (Py_UCS4)
• 无中间 Python 对象
• UCD 静态 C 表查询
• 非字母字符被跳过
• 需 ≥1 个 cased 字符

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 228px; height: 1px; padding-top: 175px; margin-left: 557px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
cased 字符 = 有大小写属性
• Lu 大写 (A, É, Ω)
• Ll 小写 (a, é, ω)
• Lt 标题大写 (ǅ, Ȝ)
非 cased: 数字/中文/符号
'123'.isupper() → False
'中文'.isupper() → False

div.div:
判断示例
'HELLO' → True
'Hello' → False
'ABC123' → True (数字被跳过)
'123' → False (无 cased)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 228px; height: 1px; padding-top: 460px; margin-left: 557px;

div.div:
短路优化
• 首个非大写 cased 字符即返回
• 最佳情况 O(1)
